report.title: The nested checklist cannot display levels correctly
report.body: ### Pre-submission Checklist - [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet - [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version ### Where did you encounter this bug? Latest stable version (self-hosted) ### Memos Version v0.26.0 ### Bug Description The nested checklist cannot display levels correctly; all items appear on the same level. Furthermore, clicking the checkbox of a sub-checklist incorrectly marks the item above it. The syntax for nested checklists was correctly supported in previous versions. ### Steps to Reproduce The testing markdown is ```markdown - [ ] task1 - [ ] task1.1 - [ ] task 1.1.1 - [ ] task1.2 - [ ] task2 ``` ### Expected Behavior _No response_ ### Screenshots & Additional Context _No response_

plan.expected: The rendered memo shows task1.1 and task1.2 indented one level under task1, and task 1.1.1 indented two levels under task1, with task2 at the top level, rather than all items appearing on the same level
plan.reported_actual: All checklist items are displayed at the same level, and clicking the checkbox of a sub-item marks the item above it instead
missing: assumed: the indentation in the report is 4 spaces per nesting level

# The nested checklist cannot display levels correctly

## Sign in
Sign in with username {{username}} and password {{password}}.
Verify the sign-in form is gone and the memo app's main page is shown.

## Reproduce the report
Open http://localhost:15302/.
Stay on localhost:15302 for the whole run and do not open any other website.
Do each step once, in order. If the app behaves unexpectedly, do not undo, retry, repair or work around it: the behavior itself is what is being checked. Check the result right after the last step.
Steps:
1. Click the memo editor input on the home page
2. Type the line '- [ ] task1' and press Enter
3. Type the line ' - [ ] task1.1' (indented by 4 spaces) and press Enter
4. Type the line ' - [ ] task 1.1.1' (indented by 8 spaces) and press Enter
5. Type the line ' - [ ] task1.2 ' (indented by 4 spaces) and press Enter
6. Type the line '- [ ] task2'
7. Click the Save button to save the memo
8. View the rendered memo in the memo list
The reporter says the correct behavior is that The rendered memo shows task1.1 and task1.2 indented one level under task1, and task 1.1.1 indented two levels under task1, with task2 at the top level, rather than all items appearing on the same level. Verify that The rendered memo shows task1.1 and task1.2 indented one level under task1, and task 1.1.1 indented two levels under task1, with task2 at the top level, rather than all items appearing on the same level.

You asked to create and save a memo with nested checklist items, then view the rendered memo.
The memo outline was entered, saved, and viewed on the home page.
The rendered memo did not preserve the intended hierarchy: task1.1, task 1.1.1, and task1.2 appeared at the same level instead of being nested under task1, while task2 was expected to remain top-level.
The failure likely occurred because the memo editor or renderer did not apply the leading-space indentation to the checklist items.
